color.note: Cool neutrals carry the interface. A light blue is the main color, eight pastels carry the softness (user labels and brand surfaces), and danger is the only status hue.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The viewport behind the work: artboards, 3D viewports, video monitors, waveform lanes. A cool gray, darker than panel, so the work reads as the brightest thing on screen.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels, sidebars, toolbars and timelines. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs, always with shadow-popover.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside value fields, text inputs, segmented tracks and wells, on panel.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash for rows, ghost buttons and segments.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels, rows and sections, and rulers. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Edges of controls (fields, secondary buttons, checkboxes), crop marks and dimension lines. At least 3:1 on panel and field in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on canvas, panel, raised, field, hover, accent-soft and every pastel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, field labels, annotations, metadata and placeholders, on canvas, panel, raised, field and hover. Not on pastels.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose; never for text someone needs to read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The main brand color: a blue lightened toward pastel. The primary button, the logo square, the selection size readout, the playhead, active toggles and progress. Always a fill under on-accent text, never text or a thin line on a light ground (use accent-ink there).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The accent blue as text, icons and thin marks on panel, canvas and accent-soft: links, the active tool, selection outlines and handles, the selection's ruler marker, a changed value.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Pale blue tint behind ink or accent-ink: value-field fills, the active segment, the selected row in a list.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: near-black in both themes, at 8:1 on the lightened blue.

tokens.name: pastel-blue
tokens.usage: Pastel blue, the soft partner of the blue accent. Two jobs: the colors users pick to label their layers, clips, tracks and projects, and soft brand surfaces (project thumbnails, empty-state tiles, onboarding, covers). Text on it is always on-pastel, never ink-muted. Never a status color.

tokens.name: pastel-lilac
tokens.usage: Pastel lilac. Two jobs: the colors users pick to label their layers, clips, tracks and projects, and soft brand surfaces (project thumbnails, empty-state tiles, onboarding, covers). Text on it is always on-pastel, never ink-muted. Never a status color.

tokens.name: pastel-rose
tokens.usage: Pastel rose. Two jobs: the colors users pick to label their layers, clips, tracks and projects, and soft brand surfaces (project thumbnails, empty-state tiles, onboarding, covers). Text on it is always on-pastel, never ink-muted. Never a status color.

tokens.name: pastel-peach
tokens.usage: Pastel peach. Two jobs: the colors users pick to label their layers, clips, tracks and projects, and soft brand surfaces (project thumbnails, empty-state tiles, onboarding, covers). Text on it is always on-pastel, never ink-muted. Never a status color.

tokens.name: pastel-butter
tokens.usage: Pastel butter. Two jobs: the colors users pick to label their layers, clips, tracks and projects, and soft brand surfaces (project thumbnails, empty-state tiles, onboarding, covers). Text on it is always on-pastel, never ink-muted. Never a status color.

tokens.name: pastel-mint
tokens.usage: Pastel mint. Two jobs: the colors users pick to label their layers, clips, tracks and projects, and soft brand surfaces (project thumbnails, empty-state tiles, onboarding, covers). Text on it is always on-pastel, never ink-muted. Never a status color.

tokens.name: pastel-sage
tokens.usage: Pastel sage. Two jobs: the colors users pick to label their layers, clips, tracks and projects, and soft brand surfaces (project thumbnails, empty-state tiles, onboarding, covers). Text on it is always on-pastel, never ink-muted. Never a status color.

tokens.name: pastel-stone
tokens.usage: Pastel stone, the default label for new items. Two jobs: the colors users pick to label their layers, clips, tracks and projects, and soft brand surfaces (project thumbnails, empty-state tiles, onboarding, covers). Text on it is always on-pastel, never ink-muted. Never a status color.

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any pastel, in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The only status hue: errors and destructive actions. As text, on panel, canvas and danger-soft; as a fill, under on-danger. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banners and invalid fields, behind danger or ink text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the destructive confirm button).

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist for every label, menu and sentence. Dense by default: 13px body.

styles.name: ui-display
styles.usage: Home, onboarding and splash titles. Once per screen.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Frames outside the range are skipped on export.
styles.usage: Default text: menus, descriptions, list rows.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Panel headers, field labels, tabs and buttons.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Metadata and hints. The smallest text allowed.

groups.name: Values
groups.note: Geist Mono for anything you could type into a field, and for the drawing's annotations.

styles.name: mono-value
styles.usage: Parameter values, coordinates, sizes, hex codes. Use tabular numbers.

styles.name: mono-annotation
styles.usage: Drawing annotations: ruler numbers, dimension labels, selection size readouts, coordinates on the canvas.

styles.name: mono-timecode
styles.usage: Transport readouts: timecode, bars and beats, frame counters.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Dense tools live on space-1 to space-3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel body padding, between field groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, between panels in a stack, crop-mark length.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page or dialog.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and home-screen breathing room.

radius.note: Small and consistent. Drawings, handles and the logo square stay square; pastel tiles round up.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Selection outlines and handles, crop marks, timeline clips edge-to-edge, the logo square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Value fields, inputs, segments, chips, label swatches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and segmented tracks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, popovers, dialogs and project cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Pastel tiles: empty-state art, onboarding cards, cover blocks.

size.note: Control heights and line weights. Pick one height per toolbar row.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense inspector rows and value fields.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, segments, inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog footers, home-screen and empty-state actions.

tokens.name: panel-header
tokens.usage: Panel header height.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines, rulers, crop marks, dimension lines and selection outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke at 24px; icons scale it down with their size.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: Square selection and anchor handles on the work.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Only things that float get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and drag ghosts. Never on panels.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px panel-colored gap, then 2px of solid ink. Follows the radius.
